findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_news" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_news · Private data: get_signal_ledger, get_my_bots, get_my_strategies, run_backtest, get_strategy, create_strategy, update_strategy, get_my_backtests, get_backtest, get_before_you_trade · Public sink: get_before_you_trade · Destructive: get_btc_chart_read, run_backtest, delete_strategy, get_my_backtests, get_backtest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_news · Private data: get_signal_ledger, get_my_bots, get_my_strategies, run_backtest, get_strategy, create_strategy, update_strategy, get_my_backtests, get_backtest, get_before_you_trade · Public sink: get_before_you_trade · Destructive: get_btc_chart_read, run_backtest, delete_strategy, get_my_backtests, get_backtest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
